description: The Monthly Notices' class, two columns by default, without usenatbib (owner decision O-MNRAS1). mnras.cls is not built on article and leaves out names that packages and General's LaTeX read. The preamble (b21, from GitHub run 41584963423) gives them without changing what the class prints: (1) \bibhang is cleared just before natbib or biblatex loads, since both \newlength{\bibhang} (natbib.sty l.637, biblatex.sty l.916) and mnras.cls already allocates it without usenatbib (l.1641-1644): 'Command \bibhang already defined' failed 5,614 mnras.A branches (585 documents hold it); (2) article's \if@titlepage, false, which abstract.sty (l.57, l.103) and titling.sty test while they load: 'Undefined control sequence', 'Extra \else', 'Extra \fi', 3,230 branches; (3) article's \abstractname, \contentsname, \listfigurename, \listtablename and \appendixname, which abstract.sty, tocloft and General's appendix (titlesec) and contents lines read (891 branches); mnras's own headings stay its fixed ABSTRACT, CONTENTS and APPENDIX (l.1118, l.1273, l.760-775); (4) \title takes a paragraph, as the kernel's does (l.1188-1190 are not \long, and General's title is a \parbox ending in \par: 19 branches); (5) \cite and \shortcite are e-TeX \protected, with mnras's own bodies (l.1664-1666), so a citation in a heading or a mark is not expanded there ('\citename' undefined, 'Illegal parameter number': 32 branches); not \DeclareRobustCommand, which would redefine the kernel's inner \cite that mnras's \@internalcite calls (l.1664 lets it to the kernel's robust \cite), so that every citation would call itself without end; written '\cite {' so that the host's scan for citation commands (keepCitationCase) does not take the line for one; (6) at \begin{document}, when no package gave them (listings, caption and caption3 do), mnras's figure or table caption as \@makecaption and empty \abovecaptionskip and \belowcaptionskip: mnras sets \@makecaption only inside its own figure and table (l.1547-1571), so captions under floatrow, wrapfig, rotating, sidecap and threeparttable stopped (190 branches). (7) A placement after \begin{figure} or \begin{table} (and their starred forms) is read and dropped (b22, owner item 'mnras floats'): mnras's \figure and \table call \@float{type} followed by a font command (mnras.cls l.1548-1550, l.1564-1566), so \@float's \@ifnextchar[ never sees a placement, the default tbp applies (l.1543, l.1559), and the placement the library and General write ([tbp], [H], [htbp]) was set as text at the top of the float, on the line of what follows it: in GitHub run 41584963423, 26 overfull boxes in 22 mnras.A cells are that text beside the float's \linewidth-wide content ('[htbp] []' 23.8pt, '[h] []' 11.3pt too wide), the only failure of 10 branches. MNRAS disables placement on purpose (MNRAS.md: '[htbp] are intentionally disabled'), so the class's tbp still applies; only the stray text goes. (8) b22 (owner item O-JR1-1), a test-setting choice for the test documents' many abstracts, not mnras's: in two columns mnras sets each abstract (and keywords) block as a page-top float box (\start@SFBbox, l.1162-1167; \finish@SFBbox, l.1168-1175 adds it to the page's \@dbltoplist through the kernel's \@addtodblcol, which takes its height off \@colht), built to be used once on the first page. The test documents hold 16 to 64 abstracts each, so every box went to the same page: \@colht went negative, the 18 float boxes ran out, and the documents stopped at 'You can't use \divide after \divide' in \@trylist, 'Missing number', 'Dimension too large' or an undefined \@currbox (F38 293, F48 125, F148-F155 8 branches in 11 abs.kernel@unindented documents). An abstract that would join a page whose top already holds an abstract or keywords block starts a new page (\clearpage), which ships that page and returns its box. The test is the page's \@dbltoplist not empty with \@dbltopnum at 0: \finish@SFBbox sets \@dbltopnum to 1 (l.1171) and the kernel's \@addtodblcol takes it to 0 (latex.ltx l.21601), while the title block of mnras's \maketitle (\twocolumn[...], l.1058) leaves it at -1 (\@topnewpage, latex.ltx l.20782-20783) and a new page starts at \c@dbltopnumber, 3 (l.1533; \@dblfloatplacement, latex.ltx l.17805). The line wraps \abstract (l.1102-1106), not \start@SFBbox, so keywords are never moved (\keywords, \nokeywords: l.1122-1146): a document's title, its first abstract and their keywords share the first page as mnras prints them, and only a test document's second and later abstracts start new pages (as does an abstract after three wide floats have taken the page's top places). The abstracts follow one another with nothing between, so the columns are still empty when the next one starts; \clearpage alone would then hand the box to the kernel's float-page code (\@doclearpage, latex.ltx l.20898-20912), which refuses it as one column wide, since mnras never gives it the 1sp depth \end@dblfloat marks a double float with (l.17762, l.17813, l.20873-20877): it would stay deferred and \clearpage would repeat until 'Output loop---100 consecutive dead cycles'. So on an empty page an empty box starts the column first, as the kernel's own \clearpage does for \twocolumn's top block (l.20704-20711), and the page ships through the two-column output with the box on top.
